立卡门: ① 过期条款：QA 运行的条款 fail 需要有人负责变绿（checklist-test §5「过期规格」），具名落点 + 复现（reach: `os compile`，实测两次 + 一次启动）
业务理由: 该项每轮发版都会被判 FAIL，而产品是对的：ADR-0143 D1（2026-10-28 接受）已把出站连接器 OAuth 放进开放层，oauth2 实例能编译、能启动。不改，发版清单永远红一格，跑的人每次都要重查一遍才知道是规格过期；新的三种按次授权（oauth2 / app-credential / signed）也没有任何清单项覆盖。
动手的读者: 拥有 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json` 的清单车道：按 RUNNER/checklist-test §3 修订该项（递增 revision、写 history、保持 `check-platform-checklist` 绿），把 acceptance[3] 与 negative[1] 指向现行契约。
查重: `connector-auth-kind-application oauth2` 13 命中（运行记录 #28965 #27438 #24615 #23922 #24575 #26450 #25815 与已关的清单卡 #25844，均不是 re-point）、`oauth2 "no authorable spelling"` 0、`ADR-0143 checklist oauth2 refused` 3（#27293 #27261 #6015，非重复）；相关上下文 #28277（DocuSign 作为首个声明式出站 OAuth 校验，开着），非重复。

QA-source: #29151 · integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application · acceptance[3], negative[1]

## What the item says, and what holds at 7fa9873f
Revision 5 (2026-10-31) of the item asserts that an oauth2 connector auth is refused at parse: in its title ("oauth2 has NO authorable spelling (EE tier)"), `variants[5]`, `acceptance[3]` ("auth {type:'oauth2'} fails parse … exactly the four static arms"), `negative[1]` ("an oauth2-authored entry building clean … is a FAIL"), `automated.ref` ("No pin covers the oauth2 discriminator refusal") and `source[0]` ("OAuth2 named as the enterprise tier").

At 7fa9873f `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema` (`packages/spec/src/shared/connector-auth.zod.ts:601-609`) carries seven kinds: none, bearer, api-key, basic, oauth2 (D2.1, grants `authorization_code` / `client_credentials`, arm at :397), app-credential (D2.2) and signed (D2.3), per ADR-0143 D1 (Accepted 2026-10-28), which reverses the ADR-0097 §3 enterprise placement. Wave 3 (#27438, c4c515ad) measured the old refusal; this run measured the new contract.

## Reproduction
1. In a scratch showcase copy, add to `allConnectors`: `{ name:'qa_probe_oauth2', type:'api', provider:'rest', providerConfig:{baseUrl:'http://127.0.0.1:42181'}, auth:{ type:'oauth2', grant:'client_credentials', tokenUrl:'https://example.invalid/token', clientId:'qa', credentialRef:'QA_OAUTH_SECRET' } }`.
2. Run `objectstack compile`.
3. **The clauses expect:** a parse refusal naming the four static kinds. **Actual:** rc=0, `✓ Build complete`, the entry and its auth in `dist/objectstack.json`; on boot the instance is listed degraded until its `credentialRef` resolves.

## Suggested re-point
Point acceptance[3] and negative[1] at the contract that holds now: an inline secret on any kind is refused; oauth2 keys are strict (`clientSecret` / `accessToken` are refused with the `credentialRef` guidance); a grant-less oauth2 is refused on `grant`. Update the title, variants[5], automated.ref and source[0] to match. Consider a sibling item for the per-dispatch grant kinds (oauth2 / app-credential / signed), which no item covers.

Every other clause of the item passed live at 7fa9873f (wire shapes on an echo upstream, credential resolution, the missing-credential degrade and recovery, secret absence).
